bridgeRouteRisk.summary: YLDS native issuance is reviewed on Provenance (uylds.fcc) and Stellar; Solana and Ethereum are Hastra wYLDS bridge/wrapper representations moving over Chainlink CCIP. The Solana SPL mint key can create wYLDS without a protocol-enforced cap and a separate freeze key can impair accounts, with signer custody unresolved. On Ethereum, verified YieldVaultV2 exposes direct mintRewards issuance to the StakingVault and SMBStakingVault REWARDS_ADMIN_ROLE holders, while upgrade/admin roles are held by TimelockController 0x4acd2c83616d42b87788ecef4039e7355dd23a39 with a 86,400-second delay; the former Safe remains proposer/admin and execution is open after delay. These representation controls remain exclusively under Bridge Risk, not Figure's native Mint Authority.

At finalized slot 439721114 on 2026-08-16, the SPL mint had supply 171,231,691.550686 wYLDS, direct mint authority AJuGsS1NrHgxpHgUu7AgCvshFGL8WdRwxks9sfAVhNQM, and freeze authority 8A18H7n3atDfQsN8rLvt98hj5WZJWwhqqR8digDvbia6. routes.reviewNote: Canonical home deployment: YLDS is issued by Figure Certificate Company on Provenance as the uylds.fcc marker. At height 32896122 on 2026-08-16, the marker was active, restricted, floating, and governance-enabled with a current 4-of-6 group policy plus five direct ACCESS_MINT accounts.

The Ethereum YLDS-tracked token is Hastra wYLDS (name/symbol verified 2026-08-16), an ERC1967 UUPS proxy wrapped token backed 1:1 by YLDS from Hastra, the Figure/Provenance-incubated liquidity protocol, with cross-chain interoperability on Chainlink CCIP. At Ethereum block 25770387, verified YieldVaultV2 roles DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, and WHITELIST_ADMIN_ROLE were held by TimelockController 0x4acd2c83616d42b87788ecef4039e7355dd23a39, whose getMinDelay() was 86400 seconds. Former Safe 0x8d358b8ae881f8ea92c3d07783abca21727c6309 no longer held those roles after revocations at block 25749373; it remains the Timelock proposer/admin, and the zero executor address makes execution open after delay. The complete current Timelock role roster was not independently enumerated. Figure's legal disclaimer notes Figure does not itself issue wYLDS.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770387 on 2026-08-16, wYLDS 0x6ad038ca6c04e885630851278ca0a856ad9a66cc pointed through its EIP-1967 UUPS implementation slot to verified YieldVaultV2 0x06e0b9155a3cf07f41ac826ccfee7ef8413a9723. The admin slot was zero. TimelockController 0x4acd2c83616d42b87788ecef4039e7355dd23a39 held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, and WHITELIST_ADMIN_ROLE, and getMinDelay() was 86400 seconds.
